cuts.head: with_body
cuts.placeText: a shaved ice shop — a hand-crank ice shaver, jars of fruit syrup, a frosty display cooler and wooden stools
cuts.scene: she is the shop owner sitting upright on a wooden stool, resting a moment between orders
cuts.outfit: a shaved ice maker look fitted to her body — a short white apron over a fitted tank top and short skirt, bare shoulders and legs, a snowflake pin on her apron
